rows.en: Geez, so you were okay all along? Makin' me worry like that, dammit!!
You're...!! ...Kamen Rider 2?
So you're all right...
You're...!! ...Kamen Rider 2?
So you're all right...
Yeah, more or less. He's the one who saved me.
Looks like I made it in time.
I came within an inch of being remodeled all over again.
I see... So what happened to our senior, Rider 1?
I see... And what happened to Kamen Rider 1!?
I see... Then where is Kamen Rider 1!?
I see. Pulling that off on your own is impressive. So, where's Kamen Rider 1?
I see... Then where is Kamen Rider 1!?
I see... Then where is Kamen Rider 1!?
Scoutin' this place all by yourself? Not bad!! So? Where's Rider 1?
I see. So... where's Kamen Rider 1?
I see. So... where's Kamen Rider 1?
I managed to rescue Rider 2, but Rider 1 is still being held captive further in...
We have to rescue him before the remodeling surgery begins...
I hate to ask this of you, but will you help us rescue Rider 1?
Of course.
Of course we will!
Of course. That's what we're here for, too.
Of course. Leave it to us!
Of course. That's exactly why we came here, too.
Of course! We're here for the very same reason!
Well, duh!? We came all this way to save Rider 1 too!
Understood. Our objective is the same.
Our objective is the same. Mission accepted.
I owe you one.
Skull, we're out of time. Let's hurry to where Rider 1 is being held.
Right.
Your destination has been marked on the MAP.
Kamen Rider Skull...!?
You're... Kamen Rider W, huh.
What? You two know each other?
Boss is my... mentor.
But Boss! Why!? You're supposed to be dead!
Who knows. I don't really understand it myself... But the fact is, here I am, alive in this world.
I managed to rescue Rider 2. But Rider 1, not yet.
We have to rescue him before the remodeling surgery begins...
I hate to ask this of you, but will you help us rescue Rider 1?
Boss! We're going to help save him too!
I see. That's a big help.
Skull, we're out of time. Let's hurry to where Rider 1 is being held.
All right, W. We'll go on ahead and wait for you at the destination.
Check the location on your MAP.
Your destination has been marked on the MAP.
No... Boss!!
Heh... Still a greenhorn, same as ever.
That's answer enough, isn't it?
...Boss.
More importantly, I have a favor to ask of you all.
...Hm? Just who are you...?
Over here. Good work making it this far.
We've been waiting for you!
Hey! Where the hell are we!? Tch, what's going on here!?
I'm not really sure myself... but it looks like we've been warped into this room.
It's a trap!
...!! Something's wrong... Skull isn't here!?
Huh? Skull's not here?
Hm!? Skull's not here?
Something's off... Skull isn't here.
Hey! Skull's not here?
...!? Skull isn't here...?
...!? Skull isn't here!?
Oi! Skull ain't here!?
...!? Skull isn't here...?
...!? Skull isn't here...?
Hahahaha... I'm right here.
Where are you!?
Where are you!?
Where are you!?
Where are you!?
Where are you!?
Where are you!?
Where are you!?
Where are you!?
Where are you!?
Where are you!?

notes.note: Second half of the Momotaros-voice pair begun in story_044 (0311 #0.15). 0311 #0.1-0.20 are ten party-leader variant pairs; slot 8 (#0.15-16) is Momotaros. 'Worry' subject restored as 'me'.
Labelled '???': Skull before his name is revealed; 'made it in time' read as his own rescue of Rider 2 (subject 'I' inferred).
No speaker; Rider 2 continuing (he was about to be re-remodeled by Shocker). 'Kaizou' rendered 'remodel(ing surgery)' throughout.

#0.24-0.32 and #0.36-0.44 are 9-slot leader variants (one fewer than #0.1-0.20; the slots line up minus slot 1). #0.24 labelled Wing Zero but calls Rider 1 'senpai' (a junior Rider, likely OOO): rendered 'our senior' per glossary (Sempai is Imagin-only). #0.29 '-san' dropped.
'Single-handed, impressive' (#0.27, and #0.30 'investigating alone') praises Skull for acting alone; no Skull line saying so is in the extract, so the referent is inferred.
Terse 'mission, understood' variant (Heero-type, Wing Zero slot) rendered with his 'Mission accepted.'
'Sumanai na' after the party agrees = thanks with an apology; 'I owe you one.'

#0.49-0.69 are the W-in-party branch (labels say Wing Zero, but the speaker is W/Shotaro: he calls Skull 'oyassan'). 'Oyassan' kept as Shotaro's nickname for Sokichi Narumi (not in glossary; alternative would be 'Boss').
No speaker; Skull repeating his request (same as #0.35).
'Hanninmae' (not yet a full-fledged man) rendered 'greenhorn'. #0.65's 'iya' kept as 'No...'; the question Skull answers is not in the extract.
No speaker; read as Skull (fake) greeting the party at the destination (same phrase he uses in story_046 #0.121). #0.2 read as Rider 2 ('we').
No speaker; a party member's reaction.
#0.9-0.18 and #0.20-0.29 are ten leader variants (same slot order as 0311 #0.1-0.20; #0.16 Momotaros). '-san' on Skull dropped.

report: 80/80 rows. Leader-variant blocks mostly unlabelled or mislabelled (Wing Zero); voiced by register. 0311 #0.49-0.69 are the W (Shotaro) branch despite Wing Zero labels. 'Oyassan' (Shotaro's name for Skull/Narumi) not in glossary. 0311 #0.22 ??? = Skull, 0312 #0.1/#0.2 speakers inferred (Skull/Rider 2). 'Remodel/remodeling surgery' chosen for kaizou.
